title: Sparse FPGS contact projection: final-head and incremental measurements

source.baseline_origin: Recorded clean-main captures in results.json; not rerun for this contact projection follow-up

sampling.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition
sampling.env_fps_scope: Random-action environment transitions per second, 16384 / synchronized-boundary mean loop seconds; not training FPS
sampling.physics_scope: Main physics CUDA graph per environment step over a separate 40-step profiling window; sensor graphs and eager environment/reset work excluded
sampling.workload: 20 native task recipes; solver features, substeps, iterations and capacities matched. SO101 Keyboard 736 ordinary rows on both arms; no Ant/Humanoid matrix-free override.
sampling.interpretation: One final-head capture per task against recorded baseline; no confidence intervals or repeat qualification of small differences.

implementation.scope: FPGS only; Isaac Lab, collision, solver budgets, task recipes and capacities unchanged
implementation.projection: Build supported endpoint Jacobians once, then project normal and tangent directions together using the existing compact factor-row ABI; no global Jacobian staging or extra conversion launch
implementation.execution: Eight lanes per contact, with a bounded worker grid and support-only packed-factor traversal; no robot-name dispatch
implementation.supported_features: Several same-topology articulations per world, independent free bodies, prescribed contact endpoints; same-articulation endpoints combine before projection
implementation.remaining_limits: One articulated topology group, at most 64 articulated response DOFs; unsupported features retain the existing path

ordinary_row_storage.scope: Allocated large ordinary contact-row arrays only. Prior per-group and per-world arrays are separate (_jy_world_aliased=false). Excludes factors, native MF rows, velocity/mask buffers, row metadata, tiny dummy views and every other allocation. Not total process/peak VRAM or memory traffic.
ordinary_row_storage.free_response_shape_note: The recorded one-world constructor probe confirms [1,192,6]; full-size allocation computed with the checked 16384-world count and final source allocation expressions.

known_failure.reason: Independent dense/sparse rollouts allocate joint-limit/contact bundles in different atomic orders; the comparison is order-sensitive
known_failure.diagnostic: Substituting only the parent scalar producer reproduces the first-step mismatch (maximum |dq| 0.089762628 versus 0.08976269). On 34 identical-input producer replays, compact indices match and maximum factor/incident/diagonal differences are 8.94e-8, 1.04e-7 and 2.38e-7
known_failure.status: Not fixed; no tolerance or fixture changes; full GB300 suite is not a clean pass

validation.direct_oracles: CPU/CUDA dense-response comparisons include 8/16/32-lane groups, 3/6/43/64-DOF cases, bit 63, partial groups, 1/3 reserved rows, distinct anchors, same/different articulations, free metrics and coordinate offsets
validation.independent_review: Read-only source review found no concrete correctness or maintainability issue; reviewer did not run GPU jobs
validation.limits: Short random-action captures are not training-equivalence or convergence proof; collision boundary snapshots and sticky row warnings are not lifetime no-drop certification. Do not credit inactive-path timing variation to this PR.

final20.artifact_hash_verification: All 80 final-run artifact hashes verified independently; 520 total comparisons including source/driver/baseline/parent hashes

producer_attribution.query: SELECT SUM(k.end-k.start)/5e6 AS ms_per_step, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL AS k JOIN StringIds AS s ON k.shortName=s.id WHERE s.value LIKE 'populate_sparse_contact_response%' AND k.graphNodeId IS NOT NULL AND k.graphNodeId!=0
producer_attribution.scope: Summed contact-producer graph-node kernel activity in a separate five-step diagnostic capture; not whole-graph critical path or the 40-step headline physics measurement

incremental.sampling: 16,384 environments; 200 warmup steps, 40 timed environment steps and 40 separate graph steps; graphs on, video off; one fresh capture per arm per GPU/task
incremental.order: Initial147 baseline → 271 discovery → fresh147 controls → finala25 captures; RTX a25 values reused from the final20 sweep. This is not two interleaved ABBA repeats at a single candidate commit.
incremental.interpretation: Kuka physics improvement reproduces on both GPUs. Cassie physics improves but fresh-pair environment time is 1.2% worse on RTX and 0.8% worse on GB300; small loop differences are not repeat-qualified.

discovery.relation_to_final: Runtime and tests are byte-identical to a25b4c45; the final consolidated commit changes only the SVG compared with this checkpoint. These are not captures made at a25.
discovery.interpretation: Separate discovery captures, preceding the fresh parent/final qualification pair. Do not combine their gains with main-to-PR gains or call them randomized repeats.
